body.interpretation: Standard Server-RPC exec wrapper, structurally identical to ServerHandshakeFromClientForReceivingCutActors. (1) Non-zero-guarded 64-bit increment of the script-frame field at +0x20 (FFrame::NextLocalVar); RBX is saved to RDX (the frame). (2) CALL the per-RPC _Validate thunk at vtable byte offset 0xc18 (index 774); if it returns 0, LEA the wide validate-fail literal into RCX and tail-JMP to RPC_ValidateFailed (0x142d6e0ef), then return. (3) Otherwise restore RSP/RBX and TAIL-CALL (JMP, not CALL) the Server-RPC body at vtable byte offset 0xc20 (index 775), with this (RBX) in RCX. The dispatch is virtual and preserved as such.
